Title: Logic Apps available in India and West US 2/West Central US regions

Body.Content:
The Logic Apps feature of Azure App Service is now available in the India regions (West India, Central India, South India) as well as the West US 2 and West Central US regions.

For more information, please visit the Logic Apps page and the What are Logic Apps? documentation page.

​Visit the Logic Apps update blog for more updates.
